title: PS Vita: planned, and open to requests
body: The PS Vita is planned for OpenPak and not yet built. It is on the list of six planned families, and it will be built after the consoles that are further along. Twenty PS Vita titles can be requested from the catalogue today. Nothing is live yet, and we will not claim online play for any game until it has been played online on a real console.
footer: OpenPak Networks — built in the open.
